reason: I might take the free call and look at the 15 companies, because it costs me nothing, but I would not commit to a pilot this month. In my business a buyer signs because he knows me from the fair or through someone we both trust, and I do not believe a meeting from a stranger's outreach turns into an order, even if I sign the messages myself.
objection: One logistics client with 45 meetings in two months tells me nothing about manufacturing or export buyers. A meeting is not an order. I would end up spending my time on calls with people who were polite but were never going to buy, and the 48-hour rule means I have to argue about every one of them.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies included two or three I did not know and could see we should supply, and they could put me in touch with a manufacturer or exporter like us who closed real orders from meetings they booked.
